lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to say Israel must not follow the practices of Egypt or of Canaan.
God tells Israel to keep His statutes and judgments, because the man who does them will live by them.
God forbids giving children to be sacrificed to Chemosh, lying with a man as with a woman, and lying with any animal.
God says the kings He is driving out have defiled themselves, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.
Anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.
